name: United Kingdom
tagline: Home to World-Renowned Universities & Rich Academic Heritage
overview: The UK is globally acclaimed for its historic institutions (Oxford, Cambridge, Russell Group), 1-year master's degrees, diverse culture, and generous 2-year Graduate Route Post-Study Work Permit.
keyBenefits: 1-Year Master's and 3-Year Bachelor's Programs save time and tuition fees
2-Year Post-Study Work Visa (Graduate Route)
Part-time work permitted up to 20 hrs/week during term time
Globally recognized degrees respected by employers worldwide
NHS healthcare benefits for international students
admissionRequirements: Minimum 55-60% in Bachelor's for PG / Higher Secondary for UG
IELTS score of 6.0 - 6.5 (Many universities offer IELTS waivers based on Class 12th English score)
Valid passport and updated resume
SOP and 2 Letters of Recommendation

name: Canada
tagline: World Leader in Immigration, Quality Education & PR Pathways
overview: Canada offers world-class education, affordable tuition fees, safe and welcoming multicultural cities, and the most transparent pathway to Permanent Residency through PGWP and Express Entry.
keyBenefits: Up to 3-Year Post-Graduation Work Permit (PGWP)
Clear pathways to Permanent Residency through Express Entry and Provincial Nominee Programs (PNP)
Affordable cost of living and tuition compared to USA
Spouse open work permit options
Safe, clean, and top-ranked quality of life
admissionRequirements: Minimum 55-65% in previous academics
IELTS / PTE / TOEFL score (IELTS 6.0/6.5 overall)
GIC (Guaranteed Investment Certificate) for living expenses
Clean medical exam and police clearance

name: United States of America
tagline: The Pinnacle of Higher Education, Innovation & Global Opportunities
overview: The USA hosts the majority of the world's top 100 universities, unparalleled research funding, Silicon Valley tech ecosystems, and 3-Year STEM OPT work authorization.
keyBenefits: Up to 3 Years STEM OPT (Optional Practical Training) work authorization
Vast choice of over 4,000 accredited universities and colleges
Abundant scholarship, assistantship (TA/RA), and on-campus work opportunities
Global tech and financial hub with highest starting salaries
Cutting-edge research infrastructure
admissionRequirements: Good academic record (GPA 3.0+)
IELTS / TOEFL / Duolingo / GRE / GMAT (where applicable)
Financial documentation demonstrating 1st year tuition + living funds
Compelling SOP and strong recommendation letters

name: Australia
tagline: Top Quality Lifestyle, World-Class Universities & Strong Job Market
overview: Australia combines top Group of Eight (Go8) universities, high standard of living, beautiful climate, and generous Temporary Graduate Work Visas with strong migration pathways in regional areas.
keyBenefits: Post-Study Work Visa of 2 to 4+ years depending on qualification & city
Work up to 48 hours per fortnight during studies and full-time during breaks
Streamlined Genuine Student (GS) visa framework
High minimum wage and excellent standard of living
Strong permanent residency pathways in regional states
admissionRequirements: Minimum 60-65% in prior academic studies
IELTS / PTE Academic score (PTE 58+ / IELTS 6.5)
Meeting Genuine Student (GS) criteria and financial proof
Overseas Student Health Cover (OSHC)

name: Europe / Schengen
tagline: Affordable Tuition, Rich Culture & 29 Schengen Countries Visa-Free
overview: Europe offers high-ranking universities in Germany, France, Ireland, Italy, and Poland with zero or very low tuition fees, English-taught programs, and unrestricted travel across 29 Schengen member states.
keyBenefits: Tuition-free or low-cost education in public German & European universities
1 to 2-year post-study job seeker visa (Ireland, Germany, France)
Visa-free travel across all 29 Schengen member states
EU Blue Card pathway for fast-track permanent residence
English-taught undergraduate and master's degree programs
admissionRequirements: Good academic standing (60%+)
IELTS / PTE / TOEFL / Medium of Instruction certificate
Blocked account or proof of living funds (€11,208/year for Germany)
Statement of Purpose and CV in Europass format

name: New Zealand
tagline: Safe, Peaceful Nation with Globally Ranked Universities & Post-Study Work
overview: New Zealand is known for its pristine natural beauty, 100% of universities ranked in the top 3% worldwide, practical skills-focused learning, and attractive post-study work rights.
keyBenefits: Up to 3-Year Post-Study Work Visa for master's and degree graduates
Work rights for partners of master's degree students
Ranked as one of the most peaceful and corruption-free countries
Practical, research-oriented and innovation-driven education
Straightforward Green List PR pathways for skilled occupations
admissionRequirements: Minimum 55-60% in previous education
IELTS score of 6.0 for UG and 6.5 for PG
Proof of funds (NZD $20,000/year living expense + tuition)
Medical certificate and chest X-ray

name: Dubai (UAE)
tagline: Global Business Hub, Tax-Free Income & Rapid Visa Approvals
overview: Dubai has rapidly transformed into a global education and employment hub, hosting branch campuses of prestigious UK, Australian, and US universities with 100% visa success rate and zero income tax.
popularUniversities: Manipal Academy of Higher Education Dubai
keyBenefits: Simple, fast visa processing with near 100% approval rate
Transfer opportunities to UK/Australia home campuses after 1st year
100% tax-free employment and business earnings
10-Year Golden Visa opportunities for top students & investors
World's safest and most connected cosmopolitan city
admissionRequirements: High School or Bachelor's marksheets (50%+)
Passport copy and passport photos
English proficiency or university internal English test
Tuition fee deposit

name: Singapore
tagline: Asia's Premier Education & Financial Hub with World Top 10 Universities
overview: Singapore is Asia's financial powerhouse, home to world-renowned universities (NUS, NTU) and top international private institutes offering internationally recognized dual degree programs.
keyBenefits: Home to NUS and NTU (Ranked in World Top 15 Universities)
Extremely safe, clean, and advanced infrastructure
Proximity to India with short travel times
Tuition grants and government subsidies available for selected programs
Asian headquarters for thousands of multinational corporations
admissionRequirements: Strong academic record (65%+ for private / 85%+ for public universities)
IELTS / PTE / TOEFL score (or medium of instruction in English)
Financial proof for tuition and living funds
Student's Pass application via SOLAR system
